verdict.rationale: Reserved or committed-use discounts are a fair question for a GPU cloud, but the evidence pack never documents a reserved-instance, commitment, or term-based discount program for sustained GPU capacity. The "Save up to 70%" claim is a general price comparison against other clouds. The $9/mo Pro tier and "cancel anytime" flexibility are adjacent pricing features, not committed-use discounts.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can lock in reserved or committed-use discounts for sustained GPU capacity
